Name: Hushah
Description: The home town of Sibbecai the Hushathite, one of David's mighty men, who struck down Saph of the Philistine giants at Gob; the town also appears in Judah's genealogies as a place founded in the tribal period.
BiblicalSignificance: Hushah gave David one of his giant-slayers: a small town's name carried by a man who faced the Philistines' champions.
KeyScriptures: 2 Samuel 21:18; 2 Samuel 23:27; 1 Chronicles 4:4; 1 Chronicles 11:29; 1 Chronicles 20:4; 1 Chronicles 27:11
